meaning.long_meaning: Badal corresponds to the Hindi form मेघ. Its core lexical sense is cloud. बादल (badal) is the Hindi word for a cloud, used as a given name. The source gloss 'Cloud' is correct. The Sanskrit lexeme for cloud is megha.
